en.title: Get Function Execution Time
en.description: Based on start/end logs sorted by time, compute the exclusive CPU time of each function; the timestamp at which a call ends is also counted.
en.input: The first line contains n m; then m lines of `function_id:start:timestamp` or `function_id:end:timestamp`. The logs form a valid nested call sequence. This site adds timestamp≤1000000.
en.output: Output n exclusive times, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definition, and watch the boundaries.
